lines.en: Dear Sister...  My shame knows no bounds...
lines.zh: 亲爱的姐妹…… 我感到十分羞耻……

lines.en: You are my Bonded, until death.  What matters most is that you are alive.
lines.zh: 你是我的羁绊，我们至死分离。 重要的是你还活着。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: That black knight...  he slayed all of the warriors.  The cultists gave us a choice - to serve them or watch the children die.
lines.zh: 那个黑骑士…… 他杀光了所有的勇士。 邪教徒给了我们两个选择：做他们的走狗，或者任凭他们杀掉儿童。
儿童…… 伊迪莉娅，艾利克斯在哪里？？
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: I do not know.  They were all taken away.  To be "re-educated" to serve Zanatus.  They killed any priestesses who dared to object...
lines.zh: 我不知道。 孩子们都被带走了。 带去“重新教育”以便服侍扎纳图斯。 他们杀光了所有敢于反对的女祭司……

lines.en: ...At least, we Bonded are reunited.  It is time for you to go to war, Edelia. By my side.
lines.zh: ……至少我们团聚了。 伊迪莉娅是时候上战场了。在我的身边支持我吧。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: I will spend my entire life's blood for you, Sister. May we be whole once again.
lines.zh: 姐妹，我愿意为你倾尽一生的热血。我们再次完整了。
